scope: Windows-specific non-exhaustive grouped format inventory. Status describes the original implemented subset or verified Windows route; it is not an exact codec count or VLC parity percentage. Profiles, containers and audible output need separate evidence.
vlcReference: VideoLAN feature documentation; broad families are used only as a non-exhaustive comparison inventory.
verification: Original sample/frame tests and independent remux validation do not prove Windows device output. Inspect per-path results in the exact Windows review artifact for Matroska, HEVC and lifecycle checks. The system status describes only the verified synthetic native AVC route.

entries.name: PCM WAVE
entries.coverage: Original integer PCM8/16/24/32, up to eight channels, with source-depth preserving WAVE export. Float WAVE and RF64 are not implemented.

entries.name: G.711 A-law / μ-law
entries.coverage: Original exact sample reconstruction in supported WAVE, AIFC and AU carriers. Decoded output is16-bit PCM; audible Windows device output remains a separate check.

entries.name: IMA ADPCM WAVE
entries.coverage: Original bounded mono/stereo IMA WAVE blocks, aligned complete blocks and fact trimming. Other ADPCM variants/carriers are not inferred.

entries.name: Native FLAC
entries.coverage: Original native fLaC reconstruction,4–32-bit samples and up to eight channels;42 exact goldens including CRC/MD5. Bounded whole-file decoding. Ogg/MP4/Matroska FLAC is not implemented.

entries.name: RGB AVI
entries.coverage: Original RGB24/RGB32 DIB frames, padding and orientation. Video only; no AVI audio demux/A/V synchronization.

entries.name: RLE8 AVI
entries.coverage: Original complete palette keyframes only; delta/partial frames rejected. Video only.

entries.name: Baseline MJPEG AVI
entries.coverage: Original bounded baseline JPEG reconstruction and production AVI output. Sequential8-bit Huffman with required tables only; no progressive/missing-table/interlaced-field variants. Video only.

entries.name: H.264 / AVC Windows playback
entries.coverage: Windows MP4 video load, dimensions, seeking and resumed clock passed native CI for the synthetic AVC fixture. Not an original AVC decoder or a general profile/container guarantee. The new original Matroska remux route still needs native Windows validation.

entries.name: Matroska AVC / HEVC + AAC-LC remux
entries.coverage: Original EBML demux and MP4 remux, one AVC/HEVC video, selectable mono/stereo/5.1 AAC-LC or audio off, and embedded plain text.512MiB/500,000 packets, known-size Clusters, bounded CFR reordering only. Independent macOS decode matched360 AVC frames,360 reordered AVC frames and60 frames each for HEVC8/10; AAC relative start was within25ms. Check the exact Windows artifact for native playback results.

entries.name: HEVC / H.265 container path
entries.coverage: Original bounded HEVC configuration/packet handling, Matroska-to-MP4 muxing and validated hev1-to-hvc1 compatibility copies. Modern Media Foundation performs compressed decoding; installed Windows HEVC support is required. Native HEVC playback remains unverified, including Main10/HDR; this is not an original HEVC decoder.

entries.name: AAC-LC container path
entries.coverage: Original AAC-LC configuration/timing and Matroska-to-MP4 remux, mono/stereo/5.1 at7350–64000Hz with1024-sample frames. Effective MP4 channels read from ASC. HE-AAC/SBR/PS and other layouts rejected. Authored silent6ch48k fixture decoded independently on macOS; native Windows PCM results and physical output are separate evidence. No original general AAC decoder.

entries.name: SRT / WebVTT and embedded UTF-8
entries.coverage: Original external UTF-8 SRT/VTT plus Matroska UTF8/WEBVTT packet-to-plain-text decoding, selection and timing. Known-tag handling preserves literal angle text. Inspect the exact Windows smoke result for embedded caption presentation.

entries.name: Embedded ASS / SSA plain text

entries.name: Microsoft Video1 AVI
entries.coverage: Original indexed8-bit/RGB55516-bit solid/two/eight-color and delta blocks, immutable checkpoints and exact seeks. Video only; multiples-of-four bottom-up dimensions, fixed palettes.

entries.name: Microsoft ADPCM WAVE
entries.coverage: Original WAVE tag2 mono/stereo predictor/coefficient reconstruction, fact trimming, clipping and complete-header partial final blocks; ten exact goldens.

entries.name: PGS bitmap subtitle rendering
entries.coverage: Matroska PGS packet carriage/track metadata exists, but Windows bitmap decoding and rendering are not implemented. The UI does not label preserved packets as visible subtitles.

entries.name: AU / SND
entries.coverage: Original Sun AU signed PCM8/16/24/32 and G.711 A-law/μ-law. Exact samples, big-endian channels, annotations and unknown-size payloads tested; float/other compressed encodings rejected.

entries.name: CAF
entries.coverage: No original Windows CAF parser or verified native playback. Kept separate from the implemented AIFF/AIFC/AU paths.
